recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of two young performers in oversized 90s streetwear, framed by vibrant vertical color bars and topped with a playful, toy-block-inspired typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a stark white void
Primary purple and green accents flanking the composition
Toy block typography contrasting with gritty streetwear
Oversized silhouettes creating a triangular base
coreInvariants: Saturated purple and green color palette
Oversized black graphic tees and shorts
Black combat boots with yellow laces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects centered, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The toy block header at the top center acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the colorful blocks down to the subjects' faces, following the drape of the quilted jackets to the boots.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subjects to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple and vibrant green for the side borders and clothing accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow for boot laces and toy block details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the borders and blocks against the matte black of the clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and blocky sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Letters are embedded within 3D-rendered toy blocks
Each block has a unique color (green, purple, yellow, orange)
Top-most word is a black bar with white knockout text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are centered within the face of the cube
Beveled edges on the blocks to simulate plastic or wood
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, heavy sans-serif knockout bar paired with colorful, illustrative 3D blocks.
graphicDevices: Vertical color bars on left and right edges

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif feel of the block letters
Suitable for the knockout text in the black bar

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of two kids in 90s hip-hop gear (oversized black tees, quilted purple jackets, combat boots) against a white background with a purple vertical bar on the left and a green vertical bar on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a row of colorful 3D toy blocks at the top center, each containing one letter of the main title in a heavy slab-serif font. Above the blocks, place a black horizontal bar with the secondary title in white knockout sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Are the side bars solid purple and green?
Are the toy blocks multi-colored and 3D?
Is the clothing oversized and primarily black?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the toy blocks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the toy blocks look like physical objects rather than flat icons.
Check that the purple and green borders are perfectly vertical.
Verify the yellow laces on the black boots are prominent.
Confirm the subjects are centered with ample white space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + white background + [Color A] left border + [Color B] right border + [Object-based] typography header + [Subculture] fashion styling.
